why:
the callback tier's send: the goal-response, feedback and result callbacks installed by `Client::set_callbacks` are what report the outcome, so this returns as soon as the request is queued. rclcpp_action folds the same thing into `async_send_goal(goal, SendGoalOptions)` -- one call carrying its own callbacks -- where RFC-0041 binds callbacks to the ENTITY, so ours splits into install-once plus send-many. Pairs with `c:action_client_send_goal`.

phase-428 (RFC-0089): re-keyed by the namespace flip. `nros::ActionClient<A>` / `nros::ActionServer<A>` are now aliases of `rclcpp_action::Client<A>` / `rclcpp_action::Server<A>`, which the extractor keys as `Client::*` / `Server::*`. The type is `same` now and the member is `ours-only`, so it no longer inherits its type's verdict and carries its own.
